title: Area of a parallelogram
summary: Cut a triangle off one end and slide it to the other: the parallelogram becomes a rectangle with the same base and height.

beats.title: A parallelogram
beats.narration: Here is a parallelogram ABCD with base b = AB.

beats.title: Drop the height
beats.narration: Drop a straight line from D down to the base. Its length is the height h.

check.question: Cut off the triangle left of the height and slide it right. What do you get?
check.explain: The triangle fits exactly into the gap on the right, squaring off the ends.

beats.title: Cut and slide
beats.narration: Cut off that triangle and slide it across by the base length. It fills the gap exactly.

beats.title: Now it's a rectangle
beats.narration: Nothing was added or lost, so the area is the same. And this rectangle is b wide and h tall.

beats.title: Area = base × height
beats.narration: So a parallelogram's area is base times height, just like the rectangle.
